ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) central distribution with high-intensity (white) margins along the superior edge. Estimated 15% high-intensity to 85% low-intensity distribution on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels form contiguous bands along the upper margins of both lobes, widening toward the distal tips. Low-intensity black pixels occupy the entirety of the central and lower fluke regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate 25-degree interior pixel angle and high vertical depth relative to the fluke's horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous micro-serrations across the superior boundary. Distinct high-amplitude, irregular protrusions at the lateral terminal tips caused by high-contrast textural clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trajectory originating from the peduncle, transitioning to a slight concavity along the superior-lateral edge toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-density clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel groupings at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the high-intensity white background of the left lobe's upper quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonization on both distal lobe tips. Single distinct circular scar/lesion with a dark perimeter located in the upper-mid region of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-intensity 'halo' effect on the dorsal edge of the left lobe compared to the more mottled right lobe superior margin.
